programs.description: Kumar finds a puzzle etched onto a human skull in his late grandfather's belongings. He consults Bimal, his friend, to solve it, and together they set out on a treasure hunt in a jungle.
Five rebellious young men, who work under a corrupt businessman, kill a police officer. They manage to evade, but their lives completely change when they learn a shocking truth.
The lives of three young couples become complicated when a dazzling woman comes between them. Soon, chaos ensues as simple misunderstandings lead to huge problems.
A good cop becomes the target of terrorists, but they accidentally kill schoolchildren on a bus. This tragic mistake leaves the police deeply worried about rising crime.
Shubhankar falls for Puja and manages to win her love after relentless pursuits. However, things take a complicated turn when Puja's brother decides to kill Shubhankar.
An aspiring policeman embarks on an unauthorised mission to investigate a devious scientist. However, he confronts various challenges when his actions are exposed.
Jatindranath Mukherjee plays a central role in the revolutionary struggle against colonial rule. He is revered for his leadership and dedication in India's quest for freedom.
An anthology of four short stories portraying the impact of money on relationships characterised by different nuances of emotions.
After breaking up with his non-Bengali girlfriend, Anand's life takes a turn when Barsha, a Bengali girl, enters the picture, sparking a new romance.
Three siblings share a bitter relationship with each other after they suspect that their father is suffering from a terminal illness.
A young man falls in love with the granddaughter of a retired colonel. When he decides to confess his love, he feels heartbroken upon discovering her relationship with another man.

When Raktim misses his train, he's forced to spend the night at the station. However, he encounters Nilasha, a mysterious woman who sweeps him into a thrilling adventure that alters his life forever.
When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.
A woman raises her sons with great difficulty and bears the financial burden of the family when her husband meets with an accident. However, things get ugly when both her sons deceive her.
Kajol, a managing director, and Sagar, the chief mechanic at a private firm, are always at loggerheads. A series of events bring them closer hinting at ending their mutual animosity.
Bhutu and Chini become best friends after the latter takes admission in a co-educational school. However, their innocence and friendship fall prey to their parents' judgements.
Arup faces challenges when his wife, Manimala, and father, Abinash, clash regarding every household matter. Moreover, she wants to leave her ancestral house to give her son a quality life.
The cheerful vacation of Sona Da, Abir and Jhinuk turns into a treacherous pursuit of the coveted treasures of King Shashanka.
Finding solace in magic, Indra keeps his problems at bay. However, his life takes a turn when he meets Kirti and their connection unveils a past life story.
Haralal finds out that his cousin, Gobindalal, holds a higher share in his father's property. So, he conspires to have the will replaced by forging his father's signature.
Pralay, Mainak and Khushi are given shelter by Kaka Babu. Pralay falls for Chandni, the daughter of a local don, and Mainak loves Sangeeta, but he soon discovers that she loves Pralay.

Three struggling filmmakers approach a top actress to finance their new movie. However, when she refuses, the trio resorts to kidnapping her and demanding a huge ransom.
A Portuguese poet, Antony adapts to life in 18th-century Bengal, blending European ways with local customs. However, he faces challenges and controversies when he marries a widow.
Four friends, Ananta, Sujoy, Ananda and Rajasaunkar, find themselves in a complicated situation when they are forced to live in a house together and the homeowner catches them causing trouble.
After getting married in a contemporary family, a woman rebels against the maltreatment of her in-laws. Moreover, she vows to take action and gets help from another educated family.
A precious ring that belonged to the Mughal emperor Aurangzeb is stolen from the house of Dhirendra Kumar Sanyal. So Feluda and Topshe, two cousins, must conduct the investigation and find the ring.
Mukti Debi lives in an old mansion all by herself while her son is stationed overseas. She hires Tareq, a former convict, to care for her estate and soon forms a special bond with him.
Captain Dibyendu Rakshit finds himself in trouble when a bout of turbulence damages the plane's engines. He must find a way to land safely before it is too late.
Gitin is unable to go on a honeymoon with his wife, Jayanti, due to his workaholic employer. The couple seize their chance when Gitin's boss leaves for a trip, only to run into him in Mumbai.
Strangers Sudarshan and Kuntol cross paths and talk about the upheavals in their lives and come up with strange solutions that have unreal consequences.
When a police commissioner is accused of treachery, his son sets out to fight corruption and restore his father's dignity and pride.
